report.summary: P-D004 (51M, commercial Employer PPO, no transport benefit) needs help with medication cost and transportation. Screener confirms a transportation need. Losartan costs $10/month. For med_cost, the Clinic Rx Fund (short-term copay help for current patients) and Community Pharmacy Assistance (Extra Help/manufacturer program applications) are appropriate; Neighborhood Pharmacy Fund is a referral link. For transport, Medicaid Ride Line and Senior Shuttle West are ineligible (commercial insurance; age 51 < 60). Paratransit Info Desk (ADA certification, up to 21 days) is the best remaining option. Transit feasibility could not be verified because no facility location is on file for appointment appt:1.

options.name: Clinic Rx Fund
options.how_to_access: Ask clinic staff to apply for short-term copay assistance; patient is a current patient with a $10/month losartan copay.

options.name: Community Pharmacy Assistance
options.how_to_access: Contact for help applying to Extra Help and manufacturer assistance programs.

options.name: Neighborhood Pharmacy Fund
options.how_to_access: Use the referral-tracking link to document the case.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk
options.how_to_access: Call to apply for ADA paratransit certification; note decisions can take up to 21 days, so this may not cover today's appointment.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: Not eligible — patient has commercial insurance, not Medicaid.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Not eligible — requires age 60+; patient is 51.
